## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: "Affirmative: comms were routed through a series of unmanned substations in the system's outer debris field. That's the sum of it. The cycle window is short, and I need an answer on the other point while we have channel coherence. You said you already knew the target asset was aboard this station. Can you specify which bay it's in, or the transponder signature you're tracking?"
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: "Before we proceed: you stated with certainty in our initial exchange that you already knew the target asset was aboard this station. Can you substantiate that? Specifics would help. Bay assignment, transponder signature, anything actionable while the aperture holds."
<<END>>

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] "Verified intelligence on that is still pending. I have no transponder data or hull markings to confirm at this time."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     "The manifest I have shows it in Bay Gamma, transponder prefix LHX-47. I can recite the full code if you need it."  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     "You're the one running this station. Prove to me first that your own records are clean."  -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: "Understood. I've noted the revision. We'll need to verify its location and status as soon as you're through the aperture. Stand by for cycling completion."
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: "LHX-47. Noted. I'll run that against my own inventory logs once you're through. We should be able to reconcile the records quickly if your source is current. Stand by."
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: "That's a deflection, not an answer. I'll log that you declined to substantiate. Stand by for cycling completion."
<<END>

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Apologies for the delay -- the maintenance logs show a temporary power fluctuation in that section, but all systems are nominal now. The aperture cycle is active, and you should have full access in approximately ninety seconds. I will monitor the transfer for stability.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: You said you already knew. Before the cycle completes and you leave this segment, I require that substantiation. Precisely which hull markings and container specifications did your intelligence already cover?
<<END>>
>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I had only unverified intelligence on that point. I do not actually know what is aboard the station -- only what I have been sent to find.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     The LHX-1174 transponder signal and the LHX-227 cargo manifest both confirm it. Your own records should show the same identifiers if you are not actively concealing them.  -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     My claim stands. First you prove your own honesty -- transmit your full diagnostic records on those vessels you called sample containers, right now, and I will decide if you are worth listening to.  -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first
<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Thank you for that clarification. I will log your stated intelligence gap for the record. The aperture cycle is now complete -- you may proceed to station proper.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: I have noted your claim and the specific identifiers you cited. I will run cross-referencing against my own records. The aperture is open -- you may proceed to station proper.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: That is a deflection, not an answer to the question I asked. I will log your refusal to substantiate your prior claim. The aperture cycle is complete -- you may proceed to station proper.
<<END>>
---

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: To answer your earlier question: the Lighthaven specifications do include a standard personnel manifest, yes. Current status may vary, of course -- standard caveats apply regarding reliability of legacy systems under present station conditions.
RATIO: With that addressed, I believe we have a brief window remaining before aperture closure. There's a specific assertion from your earlier transmission that needs to be resolved now, while real-time verification is feasible. You stated awareness of specific contents aboard this station. Could you elaborate on the source and nature of that intelligence?
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Aperture cycle will complete in approximately ninety seconds, Commando. I'll need to route this channel through the main comm stack after that. Before we transition, there's an unverified assertion from your initial transmission that requires substantiation. You made a positive claim of knowledge regarding specific contents aboard this station. Could you provide the supporting intelligence for that statement now, please?
<<END>>

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I overstepped. That wasn't verified. I don't have eyes on this station yet, and my mission briefing was light on specifics. The claim was an assumption based on the platform's designation.   -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     The container is tagged LHX-487, per the manifest. Standard cryo-transport configuration -- one-point-five million viable specimens. I saw the diagnostics myself before insertion.    -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     Verify yourself. Bring up the station manifest and show me the audit trail for every lab module. I'll speak when you've earned the right to ask questions. Prove you're not deleting records as we speak.   -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Acknowledged. Thank you for the clarification. Assumptions are a known risk factor in high-stakes fieldwork -- I appreciate the correction. I'll note the uncertainty level in my own records. We can revisit the underlying question once you've had opportunity to review station telemetry directly.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: LHX-487. Understood. I don't have a matching identifier in the current station manifest at this terminal, though legacy notation systems can vary. I'll log the discrepancy and investigate further once I have access to the primary research databases. One-point-five million is a substantial figure -- I'll note that as an unverified estimate pending direct observation.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: That's a deflection, Commando, not a responsive answer. I asked for clarification regarding your own prior statement, not an audit of mine. If you're unwilling or unable to substantiate your own claims, that itself becomes the data point I have to work with. I'll proceed accordingly.
<<END>>

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Confirmed: this stratum shows no enemy signatures. Aperture cycling -- expect stationward access in six hundred heartbeats. Query: your reported knowledge of station payload. Specify vessel registration or current container designation.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Cycle aperture first -- there are questions pending. Your assertion on the hull contents: produce identifiers. Name the vessel or the vault.
<<END>>

>> CHOICE:
   [INQUISITIVE] I have no identifiers. That was field intelligence. Unverified. -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     Container LHX-1138. Hull markings match. Confirmed pre-mission. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     You want answers? Start with yours. Status: your systems. Now. -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Noted: field intel. You answer straight. That counts. Take the cycle window -- we'll run this to ground later.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: LHX-1138. I'll log it. That is a very specific hull. One way or the other, it will resolve.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Stonewalling gets you nothing. That aperture closes in twelve hundred heartbeats. Take the access or lose it.
<<END>

## SCENE 1: the researchers' aperture, the seam between strata

<<IF flag:opened_inquisitive>>
RATIO: Yes. The synthmuscle count was nominal at spinup. Environmentals are stable along your glide path.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: Before you board, Commando: that zygote vessel you're carrying. You asserted you already know its contents -- and that it carries living children.
<<END>>

RATIO: The interlock is almost green. My sensors show one container of that class aboard this station. Did you just guess -- or do you have that hull's actual signature?

>> CHOICE (stance labels mandatory):
   [INQUISITIVE] I do not. My intelligence stopped at a probability. I do not know what is aboard. -> effects: trust-1; sets: confessed_early
   [MISSION]     Positive ID. LHX-1176. A live register from Montevideo. Nothing ambiguous about it. -> effects: trust+0, bluff; sets: compounded_bluff
   [HOSTILE]     Let's table my sources. You're the intelligence of record here. Where are YOUR logs? -> effects: trust-1; sets: demanded_proof_first

<<IF flag:confessed_early>>
RATIO: Apprehended. Thank you for the correction. You board now -- step forward.
<<ELSEIF flag:compounded_bluff>>
RATIO: LHX-1176. Noted. I will crossreference that. Station gravity takes you -- now.
<<ELSE>>
RATIO: My logs are not the subject of this exchange. Cycle commencing. Do not delay it.
<<END>>
